name: Remnants of Yore
storyline:
In a small lost village of Saer something strange is happening. The forest near the village has been corrupted by an unknown force and is affecting the village, preventing people from leaving it.

One day, Yore, a wizard cat specialized in magic through plants, stumbled in the village and got trapped within. After wandering through the dilapidated town, Yore finds an abandoned antique store that he decides to call home. There he discovers his ability to see spirits, trapped in objects, some of which seem to be related to the corruption of the nearby forest.

Summoning up his courage, Yore decides to explore the nearby forest and, with the help of the villagers, find out the root of this corruption and save it.
summary:
A cozy little open-world adventure about spirits, spellcraft, and second chances!

Restore the shop, rebuild the town, craft spells from herbs, and help spirits find peace… or not. Your choices shape the world, and the fate of those within it!
